title: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)
description:
About the job

About UltaHost

UltaHost is a rapidly growing global web hosting and cloud infrastructure provider delivering high-performance hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, and cloud solutions to customers worldwide. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable, and innovative infrastructure services while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction. As our global operations continue to expand, we are looking for talented professionals to join our international team and contribute to our long-term growth.

Job Overview

UltaHost is looking for a highly skilled Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native) to join our Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who enjoys building modern web applications across the entire technology stack while leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to deliver high-quality software efficiently. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern frontend applications using JavaScript and TypeScript technologies. Working closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, you will take ownership of features from specification through production while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance.

Key Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, and TypeScript
Build secure and maintainable REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services
Design and maintain database schemas using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL,
MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis where appropriate
Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar as part of your daily development workflow
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based development environments, and deployment processes


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
4+ years of professional Full-Stack JavaScript development experience
Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript
Production experience with Node.js and NestJS
Strong experience with React and Next.js
Hands-on experience with Prisma ORM, PostgresSQL/MySQL, MongoDB/Redis
Experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Vitest, Supertest, or similar frameworks
Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or similar
Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and modern engineering best practices
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


Preferred Qualifications


Experience building AI-powered applications using LLM APIs
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent frameworks, or AI automation
Experience working on SaaS, hosting, cloud, or infrastructure platforms
Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms
Experience optimizing application performance and large-scale systems
Passion for AI-assisted software engineering and continuous improvement


What We Offer


Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international technology company
Professional and collaborative engineering environment
Remote-first work culture
Career growth and professional development opportunities
Opportunity to work with modern AI-native development workflows
Exposure to large-scale cloud infrastructure and global software products
Dynamic and innovation-driven company culture

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the job

QUALIFICATIONS AND JOB DESCRIPTION

Ekin is a 28-year young technology company operating in 40 countries with a growing team of 250+ people. We are shaping the future of smart cities and public safety with cutting-edge AI technologies.




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related field,
Minimum 2 years of professional experience in software development,
Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: Node.js, NestJS, Angular, React or Next.js,
Knowledge of NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB; hands-on experience is a plus,
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes; hands-on experience is a plus,
Familiarity with version control and CI/CD processes using Git and tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD,
Comfortable working in a Linux environment and using basic shell commands; practical experience is a plus,
Ability to use modern AI tools and technologies effectively and responsibly throughout the software development process,
Ability to understand technical requirements and develop independently in line with project planning,
Strong communication skills and willingness to share technical knowledge and collaborate within the team,
Ability to adapt to shifting priorities across multiple projects,
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills,
Commitment to documentation, code quality, testability and sustainable software development principles,
Good command of English, both written and spoken,




JOB DESCRIPTION

Develop, maintain and improve features for our smart city platform, which serves customers in many countries, as well as our other products and projects,
Build backend services and frontend applications using Node.js/NestJS and Angular/React/Next.js,
Take ownership of development tasks in line with technical planning and deliver them end-to-end,
Provide development support across different projects, including web, mobile and sensor-based solutions, as priorities require.
Gradually take part in analyzing customer requirements and in technical meetings with international customers,
Analyze and resolve technical issues, support customer requests and coordinate with relevant stakeholders when needed,
Work with containerized deployments and CI/CD pipelines using Docker, Kubernetes and Jenkins/GitLab CI,
Write clean, testable and well-documented code, and contribute to code reviews and knowledge sharing within the team.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the job

Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

About this role:

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer (main back end focus) to work on our advertising analytics platform. We gather and process BIG amounts of data and deliver meaningful insights to our customers. We have browser extensions, databases, panelists, servers, so many servers, and a great hybrid culture with coworkers locally and across the globe.

There's a good mix of extremely difficult problems, impossible problems, easy problems, bugs, performance issues, and the occasional thing that's a joy to work on – join us!

What you will do in a typical day:


Tackle interesting performance and scalability challenges.
Meticulously refactor bunches of reports decimating code size and run time while preserving results. 
Intelligently manage tech debt while simultaneously delivering new features for the business.
Code in SQL and C# (and occasionally js) in a mixed environment (Windows and Linux but mostly Windows) utilizing AWS, SQL Server, Redshift, Mongo, EntityFramework and ASP.NET Core. 
Participate in a Kanban/Devops dev process with fluid requirements, weekly scrums, and potentially be on-call w/Pagerduty 
Be a proponent for continuous improvement, architecture, clean code, and good systems design 
We use Github for source control and Jira for project management
We review PRs! (usually) and ship often.


What you can bring:


Experienced C# developer. 
Be able to code in C#, SQL and occasionally in Ruby.
Big Plus: Comfortable reading and modifying Javascript/React.
Friendly - You will be working in cross function with a lot of cool people!
Love for data - Our platform provides data intelligence for the digital economy!


Our Engineering Culture

We believe that "Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability." We are looking for engineers who align with our core values:


 Simplicity: We avoid over-engineering. We prefer the tools we already have and the most straightforward solutions over "shiny new toys."
 Quality: We write code that is a pleasure to read because we know code is written once but read many times. We don't cut corners, and we polish to a high level before shipping.
 Extreme Ownership: We don't just do the minimum. We expect you to understand the "why" behind your work and own the ultimate goal of fixing problems at their root cause, avoiding temporary band-aids.
 Prioritization: We focus relentlessly on what is important, not just what is urgent.


Read more about some of our Technical challenges here (written by members of our engineering team):

https://sensortower.com/blog/speeding-up-the-backend-with-graph-theory

https://sensortower.com/blog/how-we-scaled-to-thousands-of-sidekiq-workers

Fraud warning:

It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.com or text. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume when applying.

To all recruitment agencies:

Sensor Tower does not accept third party resumes. Please do not send resumes to our jobs alias, Sensor Tower employees or any other organization location. Sensor Tower is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Sensor Tower will not pay any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Sensor Tower.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Payments Engineer — Acquiring & Payment Processing
description:
About the job

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) 

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 7+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role: 

We're hiring a Senior Payments Engineer to own and scale the systems at the heart of Sezzle's acquiring and payment-processing stack — the services that integrate with processors and gateways (Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Plaid, and more partners from the broader acquiring ecosystem), move funds, and keep transactions accurate, auditable, and resilient.

This is a backend-focused, high-ownership role. You'll partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Support, as well as other engineering teams, to deliver scalable solutions to hard problems in authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and disputes. You'll mentor teammates, unblock peers, and occasionally lead small project teams to delivery.

What You'll Do: 


Design and build backend services in Golang that integrate with payment processors, gateways, and card networks
Own critical money-movement flows end to end: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, reconciliation, and chargeback/dispute handling
Build idempotent, fault-tolerant, auditable transaction processing within a distributed architecture (transactional outbox patterns; queues such as Kafka, SQS, or RabbitMQ)
Operate within PCI DSS scope — tokenization, network tokens, secure handling of payment data, and 3DS/SCA flows where applicable
Instrument and monitor payment health: authorization/decline rates, processor performance, latency, and settlement accuracy, driving continuous improvement
Use AI tooling (Claude and equivalent LLMs) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, coding, research, testing, and documentation — within Sezzle's security and data-handling policies
Mentor engineers and help raise the bar across the team
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


What We Look For:


7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems
Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs
Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals: authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes
Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)
Demonstrated, hands-on use of Claude or an equivalent LLM to enhance productivity, research, and communication — you're comfortable making AI a core part of how you work and can show how it's improved your output
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Preferred Knowledge and Skills:


Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.


Nice to Have


Direct experience with payments acquiring ecosystem like; Adyen, Stripe, Marqeta, Fiserv, etc.
Exposure to PCI DSS, 3DS/SCA, network tokenization, or payments compliance
SQL-based RDBMS through an ORM
Observability platforms (Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic) for production instrumentation and alerting
DevOps / CI/CD pipeline experience; containerized microservices on Kubernetes / AWS
A track record of shipping commercial payment APIs and prioritizing based on stakeholder/customer feedback


AI at Sezzle

Sezzle runs an AI-first product and engineering culture — we start projects in Claude and expect engineers to use AI to move faster and think more rigorously. In a payments environment, we do this responsibly: AI tools accelerate how we design, build, and document, but cardholder data, credentials, and secrets never leave our secured environment. We're looking for someone who treats AI fluency and secure-by-default engineering as two sides of the same skill.

About You: 


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


Sezzle’s Technology Stack:


Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
Backend: Golang
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Full-time

About the Company

ZeTheta Algorithms (www.zetheta.com) is a FinTech start-up which has been recently set up and is developing innovative AI tools. https://www.instagram.com/zetheta.official/




About the Role

We give a chance to every talented and motivated student/ fresher intern to develop AI models from scratch within a 2-month timeframe and show case their talents. This is an extraordinary opportunity for a self-driven, technically skilled student to build a complete enterprise-grade system that incorporates cutting-edge AI technologies including deep learning.

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the job

About the job

Shuru is an AI-native technology and engineering services company helping businesses build and scale high-impact products and AI solutions.

We are looking for an LLM / AI Infrastructure Engineer to help deploy, optimize, and operate open-source Large Language Models within a secure private cloud / on-premise environment.This role is focused on building production-ready AI infrastructure without relying on public black-box APIs. You will work closely with a Turkish entity and an international architecture team to integrate LLM capabilities into a production MVP while meeting strict privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

Key ResponsibilitiesDeploy and manage open-source LLMs such as Llama, Mistral, Qwen, or similar models.
Fine-tune and adapt models for business-specific use cases.
Optimize LLM inference for performance, latency, memory usage, and cost.
Set up and operate models in private cloud, on-premise, or bare-metal environments.
Integrate LLM services into a production-ready MVP through APIs and backend services.
Implement secure model-serving and data-processing workflows.
Ensure AI infrastructure complies with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
Monitor model performance, infrastructure utilization, and production reliability.
Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and business teams across Türkiye and international locations.




Required SkillsStrong hands-on experience deploying open-source LLMs in production.

title: AI Strategist (Based in Dubai)
description:
About the job

DUBAI BASED ROLE. Relocation would be required but with highly competitive, tax free salary package.




Company Profile:




Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.




Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.




Role Summary




The AI Strategist leads Property Finder's AI engagements end to end with a set of our most strategic agencies and developers. You are the person the client's CEO or COO calls. You find the business problem worth solving, define the AI solution that will move their numbers, lead the two Forward Deployed Engineers who build it, and stay accountable until it is live, adopted and its impact is measured.




This is a business-minded, client-facing role at the level of an Engagement Manager at a top consulting firm. It is the same role as a Deployment Strategist at Palantir, ElevenLabs or OpenAI. You don't need to write production code. You do need to be able to read a data model, prototype a simple AI workflow, challenge an engineer's estimate and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical client.




Key Responsibilities




Build the relationship and find the use cases

Build trusted relationships with client owners, managing directors and operating teams; hold the senior relationship on solutions alongside the account team.
Run discovery: understand how the client lists properties, generates and converts leads, manages agents and markets itself; find where AI and Property Finder data can change a number they care about.
Define and prioritise use cases, such as listing creation, lead response, marketing spend and agent productivity, with a business case, target metric and success criteria for each.




Run the engagement and the product

Own the engagement plan and backlog: scope, sequence, milestones and timeline, agreed with the client decision-maker and the VP before work starts.
Act as product manager for what the pod builds: write the requirements, set priorities, unblock the engineers, and keep the build tied to the outcome rather than the spec.
Move solutions from prototype to production to adoption: train the client's teams, manage change, and embed the solution in their routines.
Measure impact against a control group with Analytics, and report results to client leadership with a clear storyline.




Scale What Works

Turn each engagement into reusable assets: playbooks, templates, case studies.
Feed a structured view of client needs into Product; argue for what should become a standard product for all clients.
Spot renewal and expansion opportunities early and route them to the account team, without carrying a sales quota yourself.




The Person




6–9 years of experience, including 3+ years in a top-tier management consulting firm at Engagement Manager / Project Leader level, or an equivalent client-leading role in a deployment, forward deployed or solutions team at a technology company.
Has led multi-month client engagements end to end with a team of 2–5, owning scope, the client relationship and the outcome.
Hands-on with AI: has scoped or shipped LLM-based tools or agents, understands how they are built, evaluated and adopted, and is excited by what they can do for a client's business.
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving; comfortable with SQL and spreadsheets, and able to pull and sanity-check data yourself.
Working technical literacy: APIs, data pipelines, CRM systems; can hold an architecture conversation and spot a bad estimate.
Exceptional written and verbal communication; has built storylines and presented to CEO-level audiences, and can explain technical content simply.
Commercial judgment: understands what drives a client's profitability and how that connects to their spend with Property Finder.
Comfortable in ambiguity and in someone else's office; low ego, high ownership.




Our promise to talent




At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.




Property Finder Guiding Principles

Think Future First
Data Beats Opinions, Speed Beats Perfection
Optimise for Impact
Act Like An Owner
The Biggest Risk is Taking no Risk at All

Facebook

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L




Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Machine Learning Engineers (MLE Bench) to contribute to benchmark-driven evaluation projects focused on real-world machine learning systems. This role involves hands-on work with production-grade ML codebases, model training and evaluation pipelines, and deployment-oriented workflows to help assess and improve the capabilities of advanced AI systems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable bridging research and engineering, working deeply with models, data, and infrastructure in realistic ML environments.

title: Sr. Level Artist & Designer
description:
About the job

About the Role

At The Phenix we are looking for a Level Designer / Level Artist to join our team and contribute to our game project built in Unreal Engine 5, using Nanite.

We are seeking someone who can combine engaging player experiences with strong visual storytelling and contribute throughout the level development process from designing playable spaces and building environments to integrating assets and optimizing performance. In this role, you will work closely with our Game Design, Environment Art, Technical Art, and Programming teams.







Responsibilities

Create level layouts and blockouts, developing them from initial prototypes through final polish.
Design spaces that support gameplay mechanics, with careful attention to player guidance, exploration, sightlines, scale, and pacing.
Build environments using modular assets, props, foliage, and decals, strengthening the project’s atmosphere through set dressing and environmental storytelling.
Replace blockout geometry with final assets while preserving established gameplay metrics, traversal routes, and spatial readability.
Integrate existing gameplay systems into levels and test basic interactions, collision, and navigation settings.
Work from concepts and references, communicating missing assets, required asset variations, and technical issues to the relevant teams.
Refine levels based on playtest results and team feedback, and contribute to optimization efforts to meet target performance budgets.




Requirements

Experience in level design, level art, or world building, supported by a portfolio demonstrating your work.
Strong practical skills in level creation, asset integration, and scene organization within Unreal Engine 5.
A solid foundation in player flow, spatial readability, and character scale, as well as composition, lighting, color, and environmental storytelling.
Proficiency in building modular environments, including checking asset scale, pivots, grid alignment, and collision settings.
Ability to use Landscape, Foliage, and Spline tools to shape terrain and arrange vegetation, paths, and other environmental elements.
Familiarity with Nanite workflows, including assessing mesh and material suitability and inspecting scenes using Nanite Visualization tools.
An understanding of PBR material principles and the ability to work with existing master materials, Material Instances, decals, and surface blending tools.
Ability to set up basic triggers and interaction flows using Blueprints, with knowledge of collision, blocking volumes, and NavMesh.
An understanding of how material complexity, overdraw, asset density, lighting and shadow costs, and texture memory usage affect performance, with the ability to take basic performance measurements using profiling tools.
Experience with Perforce or similar version control tools, and the ability to follow project organization, naming, and file management standards.
Ability to plan your work, explain design decisions, and translate feedback from different disciplines into practical improvements.




Nice to Have

Experience with World Partition, Data Layers, Level Instances, level streaming, and HLOD workflows.
Knowledge of Lumen, Virtual Shadow Maps, and in-game lighting.
Experience with PCG or other procedural environment placement tools.
Experience with World Position Offset (WPO) and wind behavior in foliage materials, or with performance analysis using Unreal Insights.
Ability to create blockouts and make basic mesh edits in 3ds Max, Blender, or Maya.
Experience contributing to a shipped game and creating realistic, historical, or atmospheric environments.




Including links to your ArtStation portfolio or videos showcasing your work in your CV will help us review your work in detail and respond to your application more quickly.
